Class InMemoryJavaFileManager

java.lang.Object
javax.tools.ForwardingJavaFileManager<JavaFileManager>
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.java.InMemoryJavaFileManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, Flushable, AutoCloseable, JavaFileManager, OptionChecker
public class InMemoryJavaFileManager extends ForwardingJavaFileManager<JavaFileManager>
An in-memory ForwardingJavaFileManager that intercepts compiled bytecode output from JavaCompiler and collects it directly into byte arrays. Also serves previously compiled in-memory classes as input symbols during subsequent compilation tasks.

Eliminates the need for reflection hacks when extracting compiled bytecode from dynamic compilation tasks.

Author:
anahata

      public JavaFileObject getJavaFileForOutput(JavaFileManager.Location location, String className, JavaFileObject.Kind kind, FileObject sibling) throws IOException

      Intercepts output of class files to capture their bytes in memory rather than writing them to disk.

      Specified by:
      getJavaFileForOutput in interface JavaFileManager
      Overrides:

      Parameters:
      location - the package location.
